sentiment.historyNote: Public latest observations plus previously retained observations from the same provider; missing dates are not synthesized.

meta.source: Yahoo Finance public chart / FRED / CNN index via MacroMicro or CNN / Binance
meta.priceBasis: Yahoo Adj Close; independently verified cash distributions are backfilled only when the source lacks the ex-date adjustment. Raw quoted prices unchanged. Missing latest daily closes may use a complete observed regular-session 30m close only on action-free days, explicitly flagged. Intraday: Yahoo Close.
meta.dailyReconstructionPolicy: Only a complete regular session's observed 30m close; latest daily missing; unit prior adjustment factor; corporate-action dates excluded; provisional provenance retained.
meta.notice: Five-period weights inferred from public reference snapshots and rechecked through 2026-11-06; not an officially confirmed formula. Prices and runtime rankings are independently calculated from Yahoo. Long-term RS and historical ranks remain independent approximations.
